message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large red lettering. A stylized portrait of a man with dark hair, a mustache, and a blue-toned complexion dominates the right side of the frame. He is depicted from the side and slightly behind, wearing a black suit jacket and a white collared shirt. He gazes off-camera to the right.

Taped to the center of his black jacket is a rectangular white paper with a jagged bottom edge. It contains the bold black text: "ADA LUHUT DI PANAMA PAPERS". Below this, smaller text reads: "Namanya tercantum dalam perusahaan cangkang di negara suaka pajak di Afrika. Terekam dalam proyek infrastruktur Tanah Air."

At the top, black text reads "PARA PENANTANG AHOK" and "DI BALIK PENANGKAPAN SAMADIKUN HARTONO". A small logo with "45" and "1971-2016" is near the "TEMPO" title. The background is off-white with scattered dark blue rain-like streaks. A barcode and price "RP 39.500" appear in the bottom right corner.
